clauses.why: The verses do not say it was Israel's first attack, and they give about three thousand men fleeing before Ai, not a 'rout' of the whole attack.
clauses.english: routed about three thousand men of Israel and killed about thirty-six of them

clauses.deu: schlug etwa dreitausend Mann Israels in die Flucht und erschlug etwa sechsunddreißig von ihnen
clauses.spa: puso en fuga a unos tres mil hombres de Israel e hirió a unos treinta y seis de ellos

clauses.english: was taken by an ambush and burnt by Joshua into a heap for ever

answer.note: The line omits that Israel's defeat at Ai was due to Achan's sin, and that Joshua hanged the king of Ai.
